caption: The drawing depicts an aerial view of a rectangular plot split into several sections, rendered in predominantly green tones with accents of red, yellow, purple, white, brown, and blue. In the upper left corner, there are two rectangular buildings, colored in light gray with dark lines for roofing details and surrounded by green patches representing grass and trees with canopies in various shades of green. Pathways or roads, colored in brown, form a grid around the buildings and extend vertically and horizontally. Adjacent to the buildings, a walled area contains a formal garden with four flower beds in geometric, symmetrical arrangements using patterns of red, white, yellow, and blue markings, centered around a small, blue-colored circular fountain or object. Below this garden are four large rectangular plots containing rows of crops or plants with parallel lines in pink, green, and red shades. Bordering the plots and separating sections are rows of dark green bushes and trees, some forming straight lines, others at angles, creating boundaries. The entire right side of the composition is occupied by an orchard, organized into a grid of evenly spaced green-leaved trees, each bearing colored circular fruits in red, orange, yellow, or purple. The background and open areas are filled uniformly with green, and the border of the drawing is a cream color with some green decorative strokes in the corners.
title: Depeyster Estate and Garden
